messages:
jo: Quick FYI — noticed our Kotlin CallAdapter doesn't cancel okhttp Call on coroutine cancel on Android 14.

anita: can you repro on emulator?

jo: yes, repro on Pixel 8 emulator. call.timeout() triggers IOException but coroutine keeps running.

lee: which okhttp & retrofit versions?

jo: okhttp 4.10.0, retrofit 2.9.0, OurKotlinAdapter from sdk branch.

anita: is Java adapter behaving differently?

jo: Java adapter cancels properly, so this looks like a parity bug.

lee: quick mitigation: add explicit call.cancel() in adapter on coroutine cancellation and tag requests so Authenticator won't replay non-repeatable streams.

anita: good idea. also add doc note about streaming request repeatability.

jo: filed DEVEX-3200 and pushed small sampleapp repro gist: https://gist.github.com/jo/kotlin-adapter-timeout.
